g.text: Share of workers in highly exposed occupations, by ISCO major group
% of scored workers. 'Highly exposed' is defined per index (ILO gradient >= 3; Eloundou and AIOE above the US OEWS-
weighted p67), so the polygons are not directly comparable in level. Suppressed cells are drawn at 0.
